env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
cp stdout $WORK/native-stdout.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/go.mod
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native-stdout.txt
exists $UPROOT1273/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1273/bin/go version
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1273/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native-stdout.txt
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1273/bin/go build ./...
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectproptemps

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
"fmt"
"os"
)

var failed bool

func check(name string, cond bool, got, want any) {
if !cond {
failed = true
fmt.Println("FAIL", name+":", "got", got, "want", want)
return
}
fmt.Println("ok", name)
}

type Vec struct {
X int
Y int
}

func (v Vec) Len() int {
return v.X
}

type Carrier interface {
const Pos Vec
}

type Bot struct : Carrier {
n int
}

func (b *Bot) Pos() Vec {
b.n++
return Vec{X: b.n}
}

func add(a, b int) int {
return a + b
}

func main() {
var b Bot
var c Carrier = &b
v1 := c.Pos.Len() + c.Pos.Len()
check("binary-both-sides", v1 == 3, v1, 3)
var b2 Bot
var c2 Carrier = &b2
v2 := add(c2.Pos.Len(), c2.Pos.Len())
check("call-two-args", v2 == 3, v2, 3)
var b3 Bot
var c3 Carrier = &b3
check("stmt-two-reads", c3.Pos.Len() == 1, c3.Pos.Len(), 2)
if failed {
os.Exit(1)
}
}
